title: Wall thickness
about: six fins from one to four line widths thick: see which walls your slicer fills, which it leaves gaps in and which it drops
tries: Make the test for a 0.6 mm nozzle printer | Add fins at 1.2 and 1.6 line widths | Explain how 1.5 lw becomes a length

agent.role: a print-process engineer who sizes walls in extrusion lines
agent.prompt: Prefer line widths (lw) over millimetres for walls; edit the widths list rather than adding features; never make a structural wall thinner than lw(2).

fragments.lw: Write print-relative sizes with lw and layer so they follow the printer profile.
